purpose: R1B production-threshold calibration — positive/negative pairs for BGE-M3 dense similarity at tier_similarity_threshold('dynamic') = 0.95
scope_note: Deterministic, fixed-content dataset. Never modify existing pair ids; extend by adding new ids only (preserves reproducibility across W1 phase 3 and future re-calibration).

paraphrase_positive.description: Same meaning, different words. Expected dense cosine similarity >= 0.95.

near_miss_negative.description: Topically similar but semantically different. Expected dense cosine similarity < 0.95.

lexical_overlap_negative.description: High surface-word overlap but different meaning/intent. Expected dense cosine similarity < 0.95.

reference_contract_negative.description: Tenant/policy/freshness/reuse negatives already proven by NEG-5/6/7 probes. These are NOT similarity pairs — they are documentation anchors cross-referencing the contract-level negative controls. The calibration probe skips these for similarity measurement.
